api.name: sega.log
api.doc: Appends one line to the host log (at most 256 bytes, 16 lines per callback; printable ASCII).

api.name: sega.frame.value
api.doc: Reads one named integer the host published for this frame (a read-only copy; nil when the host publishes no such value).

api.name: sega.overlay.width
api.doc: Width of the HUD overlay in pixels (128).

api.name: sega.overlay.height
api.doc: Height of the HUD overlay in pixels (256).

api.name: sega.overlay.rect
api.signature: (x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, rgba: number) -> ()
api.doc: Requests a filled rectangle; integers only, clamped to the overlay, rgba is 0xRRGGBBAA, at most 64 requests per callback.

api.name: sega.overlay.text
api.signature: (x: number, y: number, text: string, rgba: number) -> ()
api.doc: Requests text in the host's bitmap font (printable ASCII, at most 64 bytes); the origin is clamped to the overlay.

api.name: sega.scene
api.doc: Names the scene this frame belongs to (a token [a-z0-9_-], at most 32 characters; the last call wins). The host uses it only to count what was delivered per scene against the package's declared geometry; it is a claim, never inferred, and grants nothing.

api.name: sega.mem.read
api.signature: (space: string, offset: number, width: number) -> number
api.doc: Reads 1, 2 or 4 bytes (big-endian) of a declared work-RAM range; the space is named ("m68k.work_ram"); sees this callback's own staged writes; a violation is a fault.

api.name: sega.mem.write
api.signature: (space: string, offset: number, width: number, value: number) -> ()
api.doc: Stages a 1, 2 or 4 byte big-endian write to a declared work-RAM range; committed atomically when the callback returns without a fault (at most 1024 writes, 16384 bytes); a violation is a fault.

api.name: sega.input.get
api.doc: Reads the pad (button bits) of port 1 or 2: the previous frame's final input in frame-begin, the sample (with your staged change) in input, the final input in post-input.

api.name: sega.input.set
api.doc: Replaces the pad (button bits 0-255) the guest will read this frame; only in input; a violation is a fault.

api.name: reset
api.doc: Optional. Called once before the first frame.

api.name: frame_begin
api.doc: Optional. Called at the start of each guest frame, before its input sample.

api.name: input
api.doc: Optional. Called after the pad was sampled for the frame and before the guest can read it.

api.name: post_input
api.doc: Optional. Called after the input phase, before the guest runs the frame.

api.name: frame_end
api.doc: Optional. Called when the guest finished the frame, before its render snapshot.

api.name: render
api.doc: Optional. Called once per frame after its snapshot; `frame` is the frame counter.
